title: Add TIME scalar support for Open Library-oriented generation
goal: Add the smallest Siemens Open Library-driven datatype prerequisite by supporting PLC TIME end-to-end from JSON input through vendor-neutral IR and Siemens SCL generation, with real TIA Portal V21 acceptance.
scope: Add Time to the vendor-neutral AutomationType set; do not introduce Siemens.Engineering or Siemens-specific dependencies into Domain/PlcCompiler.
Map AutomationType.Time to Siemens SCL Time in SiemensBackend.
Add examples/valve-config.json using the existing AutomationDevice schema with at least Timeout: Time, Mode: Int, Enable: Bool, and CommandWork: Bool.
Add deterministic automated coverage for Time generation while keeping existing Motor behavior green.
Do not introduce block-call, catalog, port-direction, or Open Library wrapper abstractions in this task; those are separate later tasks.

requirements: AutomationType.Time exists in the vendor-neutral domain type set.
SclDataTypeGenerator emits Siemens SCL Time for a Time field and no Siemens.Engineering dependency is introduced outside src/TiaV21Worker.
examples/valve-config.json deserializes through GeneratorCli and produces UDT_ValveConfig.scl containing Timeout : Time;, Mode : Int;, Enable : Bool;, and CommandWork : Bool;.
Deterministic tests cover Time mapping and all existing SiemensBackend/PlcCompiler tests remain green.
examples/motor.json still generates UDT_Motor.scl with unchanged behavior.
tia: The exact generated UDT_ValveConfig.scl candidate artifact is transferred through the trusted Windows acceptance boundary.
TIA Portal V21 imports/generates the tested UDT_ValveConfig.scl artifact and compiles with zero errors.
